propositions: The reconciler baseline is advanced from the pass-start snapshot before outbound mutations are applied, so in the pass where rebar pushes a status to Jira, the baseline retains the old value and lags by one pass

A local status revert to a previous value equals the stale baseline, triggering _suppressed_by_inbound and omitting status from outbound, allowing inbound to clobber the local change with Jira's value

The baseline must be advanced to the last-synced value (fetch overlaid with confirmed outbound pushes) rather than the last-fetched value, gated on per-mutation success to avoid recording failed transitions as synced

All five inbound-mirrored fields (summary, description, priority, status, assignee) share the _suppressed_by_inbound guard and therefore share the ABA exposure, requiring a uniform fix across all five fields
